base.description: PROVISIONAL until PA pins the FP8 base (BASELINE-FP8.md): the wrap-up tree, FP8 KV cache, decode CUDA graphs up to bs 32 as in PA's baseline/serve.sh. The model dir is the offline FP8 conversion (G4POC_MODEL_DIR).

nvfp4-smoke.description: Harness smoke only (2026-10-04, coordinator-approved while the FP8 base is not up): gemma4nv's NVFP4 base, run with G4POC_MODEL_DIR at the NVFP4 snapshot. Never a g4poc result.
